name: Mori no Oku no Mahoutsukai
source:
Seeking to become a wizard's apprentice, an innocent nekomimi boy enters the forest alone.
Soon, a cross-dressing wizard appears before him.

"I would do anything to become a wizard."
"All right, then take off your clothes."
"...Huh?"

[Translated from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ065393.html]DLsite[/url]]
